modinfo.author: Tommy
modinfo.description: Sets all food shared cooldown to 30 seconds (30000ms) for 593 consumables (food, herbs, insects, holy water), and gives Normal difficulty the Hard-mode use action for all 548 consumables (food, herbs, insects, holy water) so the eating animation plays out. Built for Crimson Desert 2.03.02. Food cooldown based on CD Food Cooldown by Rogue69 (Nexus mod 3090). Field-name (V3) mod: DMM locates each field itself, so it survives game updates that move data.
modinfo.title: CD Food Cooldown 30s + Full Eat Animation
